run_experiment_synthetic: run the synthetic invariant regression experiment comparing ERM, ICP, and IRM methods across environments
run_experiment_with_seed: run the synthetic experiment with a fixed random seed for reproducible results
run_experiment_custom_methods: run the synthetic experiment with a custom subset of methods like ERM or IRM only
run_experiment_chain_sem: run the synthetic experiment using a chain structural equation model with configurable dimensions and environments
run_experiment_heterogeneous: run the synthetic experiment with heterogeneous effects and scrambled variables enabled
